name: Completeness
description: Check that configured columns are populated.

configuration.columns: list of dataset columns; defaults to all columns

name: Uniqueness
description: Check for duplicate values in selected columns.
applies_to: any column; strongest evidence comes from identifier-like cardinality

name: Duplicate rows
description: Check whether complete rows are duplicated.

name: Semantic format
description: Check values against a format supported by inferred semantic evidence.
applies_to: columns with a high-confidence semantic format candidate

configuration.column: dataset column with a supported semantic candidate

name: Numeric bounds
description: Check numeric values against user-defined inclusive minimum and maximum bounds.

name: Approved values
description: Check categorical values against a user-provided approved domain.

name: Referential integrity
description: Check values against an explicitly supplied reference set.
applies_to: a column and a user-supplied reference set

name: Cross-column condition
description: Compare two columns using an explicitly approved operator.
applies_to: two compatible dataset columns and a user-defined condition

name: Pattern match
description: Check text values against a user-provided regular expression.
applies_to: text columns and an explicitly supplied pattern

name: Type consistency
description: Check that non-missing values conform to an explicitly selected type.
applies_to: any dataset column and a user-approved target type
